title: NullPointerException in User Profile
description: Application crashes when a user with incomplete profile data opens the profile page.
root_cause: UserProfile object can be null when optional profile data is missing.
resolution: Added null validation before accessing UserProfile and handled missing profile data safely.

title: Database Connection Timeout
description: Application fails to load customer data when the database responds slowly.
root_cause: Database connection timeout was configured too aggressively for peak load.
resolution: Increased connection timeout and optimized the slow database query.

title: Invalid Authentication Token
description: Users are unexpectedly logged out after keeping the application open for a long time.
root_cause: Expired authentication tokens were not refreshed correctly.
resolution: Implemented token refresh handling and improved expiration validation.

title: Missing Request Parameter
description: API returns an internal server error when the customerId parameter is missing.
root_cause: The controller assumed customerId was always present.
resolution: Added request validation and returned a proper 400 response for missing parameters.

title: OutOfMemoryError During Report Generation
description: Application crashes while generating very large customer reports.
root_cause: The application loaded the complete report dataset into memory.
resolution: Changed processing to streaming and generated the report in batches.

title: Duplicate Order Creation
description: Customers occasionally receive two orders after clicking the submit button repeatedly.
root_cause: The API did not protect against repeated identical requests.
resolution: Implemented idempotency keys and duplicate request detection.

title: File Upload Size Error
description: Users receive an unexpected server error when uploading files larger than the configured limit.
root_cause: The file size exception was not handled by the global exception handler.
resolution: Added exception handling and returned a clear file-size validation message.

title: Null Customer Address
description: Checkout crashes when an existing customer does not have a saved address.
root_cause: Checkout logic assumed every customer had a saved address.
resolution: Added address existence validation and allowed the customer to provide a new address.

title: Slow Product Search
description: Product search takes more than ten seconds when many filters are selected.
root_cause: Database query performed full table scans because required indexes were missing.
resolution: Added database indexes and optimized the search query.

title: Incorrect HTTP Status
description: API returns HTTP 500 when a requested product does not exist.
root_cause: Resource-not-found exception was not mapped to an appropriate HTTP response.
resolution: Added exception mapping to return HTTP 404.

title: JSON Parsing Failure
description: Application fails when an external service returns an unexpected JSON field format.
root_cause: External API response format changed without corresponding parser updates.
resolution: Updated JSON mapping and added validation for external responses.

title: Race Condition in Inventory
description: Two users can purchase the final available unit of a product.
root_cause: Concurrent requests updated inventory without proper locking.
resolution: Added optimistic locking and retry handling for concurrent updates.

title: Email Notification Failure
description: Order confirmation emails are not sent for some completed orders.
root_cause: Email service failures were not retried and temporary provider errors caused message loss.
resolution: Added retry logic and asynchronous message processing.

title: Incorrect Date Format
description: The frontend displays incorrect dates for users in different time zones.
root_cause: Server-local time was used instead of a standardized timezone-aware format.
resolution: Converted timestamps to UTC and standardized API date formatting.

title: Cache Returning Stale Data
description: Users continue seeing old product prices after a price update.
root_cause: Cache entries were not invalidated after product updates.
resolution: Added cache invalidation when product data changes.

title: Service Unavailable During Traffic Spike
description: Backend service becomes unavailable when request volume suddenly increases.
root_cause: Service instances were insufficient and no effective rate limiting was configured.
resolution: Scaled service instances, enabled rate limiting, and configured autoscaling.

title: NullPointerException in User Preferences
description: Application crashes when a new user opens notification preferences.
root_cause: Preference object was not initialized for newly created users.
resolution: Added default preference initialization and null handling.

title: Unauthorized API Access
description: A user can access another user's order by modifying the order ID in the request.
root_cause: Authorization checked authentication but did not verify resource ownership.
resolution: Added ownership validation before returning order information.

title: Background Job Failure
description: Scheduled invoice generation stops processing after one invoice fails.
root_cause: An unhandled exception terminated the complete batch job.
resolution: Added per-record exception handling and retry logic so remaining invoices continue processing.

title: Configuration Value Missing
description: Application fails during startup because a required database configuration value is missing.
root_cause: Required configuration properties were not validated before application startup.
resolution: Added configuration validation with clear startup error messages.
